title: Development and Validation of the PREMM 5  Model for Comprehensive Risk Assessment of Lynch Syndrome

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Development and Validation of the PREMM 5  Model for Comprehensive Risk Assessment of Lynch Syndrome》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Purpose Current Lynch syndrome (LS) prediction models quantify the risk to an individual of carrying a pathogenic germline mutation in three mismatch repair (MMR) genes: MLH1, MSH2, and MSH6.

evidence.text: Purpose Current Lynch syndrome (LS) prediction models quantify the risk to an individual of carrying a pathogenic germline mutation in three mismatch repair (MMR) genes: MLH1, MSH2, and MSH6.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Development and Validation of the PREMM 5  Model for Comprehensive Risk Assessment of Lynch Syndrome》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】Patients and Methods PREMM5 was developed to predict the likelihood of a mutation in any of the LS genes by using polytomous logistic regression analysis of clinical and germline data from 18,734 individuals who were tested for all five genes.

【Abstract · abstract-1-6】External validation of PREMM5 was performed in a clinic-based cohort of 1,058 patients with colorectal cancer.

evidence.text: Patients and Methods PREMM5 was developed to predict the likelihood of a mutation in any of the LS genes by using polytomous logistic regression analysis of clinical and germline data from 18,734 individuals who were tested for all five genes.
External validation of PREMM5 was performed in a clinic-based cohort of 1,058 patients with colorectal cancer.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Development and Validation of the PREMM 5  Model for Comprehensive Risk Assessment of Lynch Syndrome》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-5】Discrimination was evaluated by the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), and clinical impact was determined by decision curve analysis; comparisons were made to the existing PREMM1,2,6 model.

【Abstract · abstract-1-8】PREMM5 distinguished carriers from noncarriers with an AUC of 0.81 (95% CI, 0.79 to 0.82), and performance was similar in the validation cohort (AUC, 0.83; 95% CI, 0.75 to 0.92).

evidence.text: Discrimination was evaluated by the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), and clinical impact was determined by decision curve analysis; comparisons were made to the existing PREMM1,2,6 model.
PREMM5 distinguished carriers from noncarriers with an AUC of 0.81 (95% CI, 0.79 to 0.82), and performance was similar in the validation cohort (AUC, 0.83; 95% CI, 0.75 to 0.92).
